title: Peace Delivered, Emma:
format: 4:5 carousel · 1080×1350 stills (the brief asks for a 4:5 Instagram carousel)
headline: One named New Yorker, one real exchange: Emma is reading on a bench, a stranger hands her a message of peace, and they hug.
story: This carousel is one person: Emma, reading in Washington Square Park. Kalindi from Search for Common Ground walks up, gives her a card and tells her why she is doing it. It ends in a hug.
The six slides are built (2 Sept, from the RAW MXF). This page is the plan for the final set: the same slides with the fixes in each row, then the call to action with the SFCG logo.
do: Keep it one person, in this order: reading, the approach, the hug, why, her name, the ask.
Every quote is word for word from the clip.
Name her with a small super, first name only.
Fill every slide to the edge: no black bars.
SFCG horizontal logo and sfcg.org on the last slide only.
dont: No Preemptive Love branding. Never SFCG or CGLA as a label (sfcg.org as the web address is fine).
Do not put words in Emma's mouth: her only line is “Emma.”
Do not open on a close-up with no setup.

bp_intro: Still carousel, 4:5. Every picture on this page is the built slide in 02 Emma, One Peacemaker (cut from the RAW MXF, 2 Sept). Quotes and times are from the Day 1 machine transcript of 764_3805.MXF (mm:ss.s in the clip); check who speaks on scrub.

rows.frame_alt: Emma, long curly hair, black graphic tee, reads a paperback on a park bench in Washington Square Park. Chip at the top: PEACE, DELIVERED. Big white capitals low: SHE WAS JUST READING IN PUBLIC.
rows.visual: Emma reading on the bench, before anyone walks up (764_3805.MXF, before 00:04). Built slide: 01_hook.jpg. Fill the whole 4:5 frame: the built slide has thin black bars at the top and bottom, so scale the still up until they are gone.
rows.motion: Hook text on slide 1: SHE WAS JUST READING IN PUBLIC, white bold capitals in the lower third. Chip at the top: PEACE, DELIVERED. No logo, no title card.

rows.frame_alt: Kalindi, in a blue striped shirt, holds out a card to Emma on the bench; the photo sits on a charcoal field. Label at the top: A STRANGER WALKS UP. Serif italic quote under it.
rows.visual: The handover: Kalindi holds out the card and Emma looks up (764_3805.MXF around 00:04). Built slide: 02_handover.jpg.
rows.motion: Small label at the top: <q>A STRANGER WALKS UP</q>. Her words in the quote style under the photo.

voice.quote: Ready? Can I give you this? It's a message of peace for you today.
voice.src: 764_3805.MXF 00:04.0 to 00:22.6 (the words are spread out in the clip: check the picture and sound on scrub)

rows.frame_alt: Emma smiles wide over Kalindi's shoulder as they hug in the park. Blue quote pill low in the frame. Black bars at the top and bottom.
rows.visual: The hug (764_3805.MXF around 03:40). Built slide: 03_personal.jpg. Scale the still up so the black bars at the top and bottom are gone.
rows.motion: Her words in the blue quote pill, low in the frame.

voice.quote: peace is so personal to every person.

rows.frame_alt: The hug from a wider angle, Kalindi's back to camera, Emma smiling; blue fields above and below. Label at the top: WHY SHE DID IT.
rows.visual: The hug, wider (764_3805.MXF around 03:41). Built slide: 04_why.jpg. “She” in the label is Kalindi, the stranger who walked up.
rows.motion: Small label at the top: <q>WHY SHE DID IT</q>. Her words under the photo, word for word (the built slide shortens them: see decisions).

voice.quote: So literally today I'm going around New York like passing messages of peace to strangers and hoping to like brighten their day.

rows.frame_alt: Emma fixes her hair after the hug, Kalindi's back to camera. A blue pill low in the frame. A black bar at the top.
rows.visual: After the hug, Emma close to camera (764_3805.MXF around 03:42). Built slide: 05_emma.jpg. Scale the still up so the black bar at the top is gone.
rows.motion: Small name super: <q>Emma</q>. She only says “Emma.” when Kalindi asks her name, so the built pill “My name's Emma.” is not her words: change it to the name alone. No surname.

rows.frame_alt: Royal-blue slide: EVERYONE IS A PEACEMAKER in white capitals, a serif italic line under it, SFCG.ORG at the bottom. No logo.
rows.visual: The call to action on royal blue. Built slide: 06_cta.jpg. Add the SFCG horizontal logo (white) above sfcg.org. The logo is on this slide only.
rows.motion: Headline <q>EVERYONE IS A PEACEMAKER</q>, then <q>Emma was just reading on a bench. Become a monthly donor.</q>, then the SFCG horizontal logo and <q>sfcg.org</q>.

1080×1350 (4:5) JPG per slide. A 16:9 still filling a 4:5 slide is a crop: keep faces whole and away from the text.
Quotes word for word in the serif italic, in the blue pill or on the charcoal field. Labels in heavy sans capitals.
Slides 01 to 06 in this order. File names 01 to 06.
None: still slides. The post caption (written by SFCG or Atdhe) carries the rest.
Six JPGs, 1080×1350. Upload as one set, named Traditional_SFCGPeaceDeliveredEmmaCarousel001-1_01.jpg to _06.jpg, to the Search for Common Ground folder in Frame.io (no batch folder yet: tell Nick).
checklist: Slide 1 is Emma reading, with the hook text and the PEACE, DELIVERED chip. No logo.
No black bars on any slide (slides 1, 3 and 5 have them now).
Every quote matches the clip word for word.
Slide 5 shows the name Emma alone, as a small super. No surname, no made-up line.
The quotes on slides 2 to 4 are Kalindi's; nothing on the slides says they are Emma's.
The last slide has the SFCG horizontal logo and sfcg.org. No logo anywhere else.
Search for Common Ground is spelled right wherever it appears.

decisions.b: The Peace Delivered push ran 1 to 21 Sept. These slides were built on 2 Sept and never went to SFCG. Atdhe decides: send them to Kalindi now as an evergreen Peace Delivered post, or close the item.
The built slide shortens Kalindi's line (it drops “literally” and “like”). Atdhe signs off the shorter copy, or the slide uses her exact words.

decisions.t: One look for all three carousels
decisions.b: This set uses the older look (blue #1E6FD6 pills, serif italic). The ten 3-slide Peace Delivered sets use the SFCG Brand Refresh 2024 look with the logo band. Atdhe picks one look for all.
Confirm Emma's release with Kalindi before she fronts a donor ask, and Atdhe signs off the call-to-action wording against SFCG's monthly-donor ask.

client_note: Why this matters: SFCG wants people to see that an ordinary stranger can be a peacemaker. Kalindi asked for carousels of screen grabs with their words on them.
ask_examples: Who says the lines on slides 2 to 4?
How do I get rid of the black bars?
